anchor: in not_judged, each with one sentence on why it is not the one tracked.
insert: When the outcome names a figure together with the share of it that one kind makes up, or with whether supply stays short of demand or capacity keeps pace with it, the two are one bet seen from two sides, not several things with none the main one: ask the figure, and list the share or the shortage in not_judged. A bank's total lending named with the share that is commercial lending is asked as the total lending; a retailer's holiday sales named with whether its shelves run short are asked as the sales; a utility's power demand named with whether its generating capacity keeps pace is asked as the demand.
